nom: Vichy 16% Pure Vitamin C Brightening Serum

avis.texte: I got a sample size of this, within 2 weeks of using it I broke out with the worse case comedones i've ever had. Literally gave my skin texture when I barely had any. Im still recovering. Im not saying this will happen to everyone, but be aware it could happen. I have combination skin.
Got a sample of this and it made my face, neck and even fingernails turn orange. I'll never buy this.

I had used this product for years it oxidizes too fast and lately the bottles are oxidized before they are even open or expired..My guess they arent stored properly at ULTA i have switched to the Korean vit C care works better and doesnt oxidize as fast
I bought this product a few weeks ago and it's already oxidizing…turning bright orange! I store in a cabinet completely away from light. What a waste of money

This started off as a great product, but then after only a short time, the contents started oxidizing, which means that they are less effective. For me to still have over half a bottle of basically useless serum is frustrating. Vichy needs to change the packaging so that the product gets less air exposure.

Oh my gash. This takes away dullness like no other. Always always apply this after you wash your face and tone. Let it absorb for a few min and then do your next steps. I get so many compliment on my skin now. Love pairing this with the Paula's choice toner! Def a repeat purchase.
This smells terrible. My husband says he dosent think it dmells tha bad but its terrible

I actually found this product on a clearance shelf at another store, I looked up the reviews and saw it had various great reviews from different websites/customers. I am on day 3 and I am so thrilled with the results. My skin is already looking so much better. Dark spots and acne scars appear lighter, and overall my skin looks healthier. This is the only item I added or changed to my routine, and I see a vast difference already. will continue to use this product and would recommend! Sources say, it can cause slight purging of the skin, so if this breaks you out temporarily, keep using, it will clear up!

As a 49 year old who has spent minimal time in the sun until the last few years-I had no spots and very little freckles; but bc I bought into the no sunscreen bs I ended up with age spots and freckles! Since using this 2-3 days per week under my moisturizer and sunscreen my spots are fading, my skin glows and seems more smooth. I have no problem using it. I also do microdermabrasion 2x a year so I am sure that also helps!

26(F) noticed signs of aging, and this was highly recommended to me. Since starting this, I have been breaking out in terrible acne around my mouth and chin. I didn't know that this was a very strong serum that would ruin my skin :(

Purchased after seeing an influencer rave about this product, but I was disappointed. I've tried several different vitamin C serums, and this has been my least favorite. The formula is very watery and doesn't feel like it absorbs into my skin during application. I haven't noticed any improvements, and I don't plan to repurchase.

I like the high concentration of vitamin c, but I don't like how runny the product is. This is my first time using it, but I likely will not purchase again based solely only on the liquidity. Other than that, the product is great.
Within 2 days of starting this product in my routine, my skin was GLOWING. WOW wow wow wow!!!

avis.titre: Not the best- moved on to OLEHENRIKSEN
avis.texte: Just not the best one I've tried. The OLEHENRIKSEN vitamin is much better and I use it daily now.

avis.titre: old formula and product packaging was better
avis.texte: I used to love this product, it had a great formula that worked well and always left my face feeling and looking great. I especially loved the individual glass ampules that kept the serum fresh and prevented oxidization. I read that they recalled the glass ampules because they were deemed hazardous when opening, but I never had problems and really miss the freshness of opening a new ampules.

avis.titre: Great Vitamin C serum, annoying to apply
avis.texte: Been using this Vitamin C serum for a few months and it works great! The only issue is applying it since the tip is so small and it ends up dripping off my face sometimes. Other than that, I would give it a higher rating if it were easier to use.
Two previous bottles in a row that i purchased were already oxidized.

I liked this product overall. I liked that it was a higher viramin C serum and I liked the results. But the bottle/applicator is terible. I dont get the point of the squeezey tip. Its very thin so it drips down your face immediately. So I apply a frw drops in my hand and press it on my face but my hands ate stained oragnge. The bottle is amber butnnot dark enkugh that the serum definitely oxidizes and feels less potent over time. Definitely not repurchasing because there are other less expensive or equal priced producrs that are less of a hassle.
Stained everything orange-towels, clothes, i walked around looking like an oompa loompa
Have become totally addicted to Vichy. Products do a great job exactly as described (YES) and have a calming effect on my beautiful aging skin ❤️

avis.titre: Big difference in my dark spots
avis.texte: When I first used this I was not happy with the dropper lid. Once I got use to it I was more than satisfied with this product. It's been a game changer in my skin. I use this along with the retinol. Combined its made a huge difference in my dark spots.

avis.titre: The Vichy Vitamin C Serum is a game-changer
avis.texte: The Vichy Vitamin C Serum stands out for its exceptional effectiveness and gentle, breakout-free formula. After just one application, I saw noticeable improvement in my melasma, and my skin feels and looks incredibly smooth and radiant.

avis.titre: Great C serum, lower cost replacement for CE Ferulic
avis.texte: This is a great vitamin C serum, easy to use. I think it is a great replacement for other brand serums like SkinCeuticals CE Ferulict that cost 3x as much, and it smells better.
I'm surprised that no one has mentioned that it leaves your skin orange. My face and hands have orange, especially in the creases of my palm. I will not repurchase.

I'm a serum lover but have never used a vitamin c serum. I've clearly been missing out. After over a month of use my skin is visibly brighter and more radiant. It's has a silky smooth texture and absorbs easily into my skin. Definitely something I would use regularly.

The VitaminC has a bright yellow color, and hasn't oxidized for ~3 weeks since I opened the bottle. One thing I like is the bottle is small, which I hope I can finish it before it oxidizes. The serum absorbs pretty quickly. The smell is not bad. I don't think my wrinkles significantly reduced but I do think it is slightly getting better so I am just going to be consistent

I'm a big fan of Vitamin C serums and my dry skin really glows when I incorporate it into my routing. This serum is very lightweight and absorbs rapidly fast. For me personally, I found that it was hard to spread on my skin since it's so dry but would definitely recommend for someone with combo or oily skin. It's gentle and the dispenser is sure to make it last a long time!
I used this product every morning before my moisturizer. It went on smooth and left no irritation or shine.
This product really brightened & smoothed my skin! This entire brand is amazing, highly recommend!
Loved how lightweight and fast absorbing this serum is. I can apply moisturizer afterward so much quicker than other serums. It's feels luxurious too - very good vitamin C serum!
Have been using for a couple weeks. The feel is lightweight doesn't clog pores and skin is not oily. Will continue to use to see if skintone evens out

avis.titre: Finally an Affordable Quality Vitamin C
avis.texte: This product goes on smooth, absorbs well, and will leave you feeling brighter. I was skeptical because I've tried really expensive Vitamin Cs like Skincueticals but just couldn't afford to keep purchasing such expensive products. This is definitely inline with a lot of accessible skincare as far as price. I have always suffered from skin texture issues as well as dull skin. This product had me looking brighter in about a week! My skin tone evened out, my texture had calmed down and my redness had also settled down! Very happy with this product. I will say that when using, you should be on top of your sunscreen because it did make me skin more sensitive to the sun when I forgot sunblock.
I have sensitive skin and this Serum wasn't harsh on my skin and I could notice positive results the next day.

This was the perfect addition to my skin care routine that was missing. This is vitamin C with vitamin E and hyaluronic acid. This leaves me feeling brightened and clear and youthful. This will be a repurchase.

While I have only been using this product that I received for free for a couple weeks, I have noticed my skin feeling smoother and a tad more brighter. I think a product like this shows better results when it's used for a longer period of time.
I've been using this product for awhile now since I got it and can't believe I wasn't using this in my skincare routine til now! The results are very evident and I'm super impressed

Been using the LiftActiv 16% Vitamin C Serum for a few weeks, and I'm genuinely impressed with the results. The serum is very lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a sticky residue, which I love cause it allows me use my other products. I also like that it's fragrance-free. The thin mouth of the applicator allows me to get just enough. I didn't have any reactions to it. As with other products will continue to use for a while to see if there is any difference in my skin. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking to add a reliable, potent vitamin C product to their skincare routine.

LiftActiv sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program and this review is based on that sample I absolutely love liftactiv 16% vitamin C serum! It is a life changer to my morning skin care routine. It absorbs super quickly and It is non sticky and non greasy either. It's got a very subtle and pleasant scent, I love it.

I feel like I noticed a difference right away. It has a weird texture after it is on (sort of sticky) but when you use moisturizer and/or sunscreen after, it goes away. Pleasant smell. I plan to make it a staple in my skincare!

I have been using this for a couple of months now and see a slight improvement in my skin texture. I like that the texture of the product is not sticky and has no strong scent. The 16% vitamin C seems like it is the right amount of vitamin C for my skin without it being too drying or harsh. Overall good product and would order it again.

LiftActiv sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program and this review is based on that sample. Pros: lightweight, not sticky, doesn't have the "hot dog smell" like other vitamin c serums Cons: the dispenser is awful in my opinion - the plastic top stains (see picture) and feels cheap. I'm not sure it's keeping air out of the bottle which is crucial for vitamin c stability. And nowhere on the bottle or package does it say how much to use so I may have been using too much or too little. It also doesn't mention how to properly store the product to maximize its life.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This is a thin, fragrance free serum that quickly soaks into your skin with no sticky or greasy residue. I experienced no irritation, even on the more sensitive areas of my face. I feel that my skin looks softer and more even after a couple of weeks of using this every morning. It is an excellent vitamin c serum that is effective without burning or drying my skin.

I use this product consistently in the mornings before I used my sunscreen. It was really lightweight and did not leave my skin feeling greasy. After a couple of weeks, I definitely noticed sun spots and discoloration starting to fade.

avis.titre: Pretty darn good for the price
avis.texte: I loved that it left my face feeling refreshed - it is not greasy or oiley at all, absorbs so well! Wasn't a fan of the plastic tip at all, I ended up putting a dropper in that I had on hand. Other than that, totally great!

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. I am a devoted Vit C serum user and have been using it for years as the first step in my morning skincare routine (after cleansing). My holy grail is Obagi 20% and I repurchase it over and over again. I've tried many brands and nothing compares to Obagi but this may be added to the rotation. The Vichy LiftActiv 16% feels just like higher end competitors at a fraction of the cost. It has a slight fragrance, absorbs quickly and leaves my skin brighter. Vit C is so important to pair with your spf to boost it's efficacy.

avis.titre: You're going to want to share this gem with your friends
avis.texte: I couldn't wait to get my hands on Liftactiv vitamin C serum. I signed up to try a sample and was so pleased with the results even after one application. My skin looks and feels so fresh. I wish I knew about this product sooner. This will now be part of my daily routine.
The liquid was very thin for a serum and it left my face feeling sticky after using it. It did not work well under makeup so I tried using it at night on my clean face.
I like the product and probably would purchase it for continued use. While applying the product, it did seem oily, but once applied, it blendesd into my skin quite well and the oilness disappeared.

avis.titre: Nice serum, easy to add into routine
avis.texte: The nozzle is a little unique but if you let some product pool into the middle part and then gently squeeze into hand you can control the amount. I found it to be non-sticky and layered nicely with my morning skin routine. After about a week I started to notice some brightening. This was very gentle on my skin.

This serum is like a tall glass of orange juice for my face, minus the sticky mess. This stuff has *serious* Vitamin C power—16%—which I'm pretty sure is the skincare equivalent of turbo mode. It goes on smooth, absorbs in seconds (I don't have time to wait around!), and there's zero strong smell or sticky residue. My skin looks brighter, smoother, and somehow way more awake than I am most days. Plus, no alcohol means no surprise dryness. My fine lines are already looking a bit softer, and my skin has this nice, healthy glow. Highly recommend if you want skin that looks like it actually gets eight hours of sleep!

Thanks to buzzagent for the vitamin c serum to try! The serum went on so smooth without any after smell. It was a tiny bit tacky till it dried but didn't dry out my skin. I used it for a little over a week and did notice a brighten tone to my skin! Can't wait to keep wearing it and see the difference

I often use a vitamin C serum, or other products with antioxidants, so I was interested when Vichy sent me a sample of the LiftActive 16% Vitamin C serum to try and review through BzzAgent's sampling program. I did not know i would like this product as much as I do! It goes on silky and feels soft on skin. I enjoy it alone under moisturizer or mixed in. It helped clear my monthly hormonal breakouts, and gave me a little "glow", without irritating my skin. I feel i saw more visible results with this than several other similar products. One note... it comes in a dropper top bottle that might be a little awkward for some people, (maybe a pump might work better?). But, the product is great and I'll definitely continue to use it!

I really like the texture of this product - it absorbs well, and is a liquidy texture. Can kind of be more difficult to apply since its watery, but I just put the dropper directly onto the face. There isn't any weird film that is left behind, like I have felt with other vitamin c serums. Leave my face feeling nice and hydrated too

Vichy LiftActiv Pure Vitamin C is a game-changer for brightening and revitalizing my skin. The formula contains 15% pure vitamin C, which has really helped reduce dark spots and make my skin look more radiant and smooth. I noticed a difference within just a few weeks of using it. The serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy residue. It works well under makeup, and I love that it's paraben-free and suitable for sensitive skin. If you're looking for an effective antioxidant serum, this one is definitely worth trying!

So what can I say? When I was asked to try Vichy LiftActiv 16% Vitamin C Serum, I said sure. I didn't have any expectations but I would give it a try. So when received the product, I added it to my morning routine beginning the next day. Wow! My skin felt amazing. It as not heavy or did it leave my skin stripped of moisture. It was like my skin was breathing. I loved it. I have been using it for the last week and my skin look as if I have been to the spa for a facial, my fine lines look smoother and my skin feels so supple.

It has a lightweight feel, which I love because it absorbs almost instantly without leaving any sticky residue. It's obviously very fluid, which all Vitamin C serums I tried so far are, which makes it a little difficult to apply. My skin seems to look brighter and feels smoother, especially around my cheekbones where I usually notice a bit of dullness. There was a slight tingling on the first application, but nothing uncomfortable, and I feel like it's helped give my skin an extra boost in radiance. I'm excited to see if the fine lines soften more with continued use.

The LiftActiv Vitamin C Serum shines as a top contender in the market, especially for those with sensitive skin. Its gentle yet effective formula makes it a standout choice, offering the benefits of Vitamin C without irritation. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a reliable, skin-friendly boost of radiance.
So smooth on the skin- doesn't feel sticky or oily, melts right in your skin
The LiftActiv Vitamin C Serum is a superior option, it became my favorite.. works amazing especially for sensitive skin, it provides the benefits of Vitamin C while minimizing the risk of irritation.

Firstly, I really like the packaging. It is perfect to apply the right amount without any waste or leakage. Secondly, I noticed results after just a few days. My skin started glowing and looked super healthy. I can't wait to see how my skin is going to look in a few weeks!

I received this product as a free sample from Bzz agent. I use it nightly after I apply serum. I have a bit of hyperpigmentation and dark spots which I'm hoping this product will help brighten. The applicator makes it super easy to use. The product is light and does not make my face feel greasy since I have oily skin. I'm looking forward to continue using this product and see the results at the end.

Thank you Vichy Laboratories for the free sample of LiftActiv 16% Vitamin C Serum. This product has left my skin feeling light and smooth. The fragrance is light and not overwhelming. The product is not greasy. I would continue to use this product.

I received this product for free in exchange of an honest review. I love this Vitamin C serum! I have been using it everyday in the morning and notice a glow to my skin. I use this as recommended mixed with a moisturizer as otherwise it is pretty watery in itself. This is a daily staple in my skin care routine!

I received the Vichy Laboratories LiftActiv 16% Pure Vitamin C Brightening Serum in exchange for an honest review. I think it is okay. There is a lot of information on the box and under the label, including directions, but they don't state how much of the product to apply or what technique to use to apply it. You have to conduct further research of the product online to find the answer. It's a liquid and more difficult to apply. The squeeze dropper may be difficult for some to use with one hand. The product is drying which is stated when you read under the label. I did not have any noticeable differences using this product.

I recently started using the LiftActiv 16% Vitamin C Serum, and I can't express enough how impressed I am with the results! From the moment I applied it, I knew I had found a game-changer for my skincare routine. Texture and Application: The serum has a lightweight, silky texture that glides effortlessly onto the skin. It absorbs quickly without any greasy residue, making it perfect for layering under my moisturizer and sunscreen. I love how refreshing it feels on my face, especially in the morning. Immediate Brightening Effect: After just a few uses, I noticed a visible difference in my skin's brightness. The 16% Vitamin C concentration really delivers! My complexion looks more radiant and even-toned, and I've received compliments on my skin's glow. Long-term Benefits: I've been using this serum for about a month now, and I've already seen a reduction in dark spots and an overall improvement in skin texture. The fine lines around my eyes seem less pronounced, which is a huge plus! It feels like this product is not just providing a quick fix but is actively improving my skin over time. Scent: The serum has a subtle, pleasant scent that's not overpowering, which is a bonus for someone like me who is sensitive to strong fragrances. Packaging: I appreciate the thoughtful packaging as well; the dropper design allows for precise application, and the bottle is designed to protect the serum from light, ensuring that the Vitamin C remains stable and effective. Overall Impression: The

This is 16% vitamin C and I will say it's not irritating. I have dry sensitive skin and this does a good job. It says that after 72 hrs skin looks more even radiant. I can't say that it did any of that, but I will continue to use to see if some of my fine lines smooth out.
Love the feel of this on my face . Definitely will be buying this

I have combination skin and sometimes can be dry and sometimes oily this serum is great never caused any irritation only inprovments. It absorbs fast after few uses my dark spots were fading and looked brighter and even my lines were less visible. I will be continuing using this.
I absolutely loved this serum. Makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated. And I can't wait to see how young it makes me look after using it for a while!
Ive been using this fir seversl months. It has madeca huge difference in my skin. Im 51.

avis.titre: Best Vitamin C Serum I've Used
avis.texte: I have tried several Vitamin C serums and tried to find products with a higher percentage of vitamin C and this is the best one I've found. Once you get used to the applicator its easy to use. I like how it absorbs and its not sticky and has no scent. I will continue to use this product and would recommend that anyone who wants a good vitamin C serum give it a try.

avis.titre: Great product that's difficult to apply
avis.texte: I would have given this 5 stars of it weren't for the way the nozzle is designed. overall the product makes my skin glow and is absorbed quickly. however the nozzle on the lid makes it nearly impossible to control how much is applied. a dropper style applicator would have worked much better

I really like this product because it's pure vitamin c with no fillers or fragrance like many other brands have. After applying you must allow at least one minute before applying any other products which is industry norm. My only complaint would be it not being in the individual mini vials any longer as the larger bottle is a bit more difficult to get out only the fault amount. But the product itself is one of the best on the market for is price and pure vitamin c level

I was looking for a good Vitamin C and came across this one and decided to give it a try. It feels nice going on and sinks in quickly. It didn't irritate or dry out my skin which is a big plus for me as i have dry skin. Sadly i ended up breaking out with large pimples that are taking forever to go away. As i woman that it is almost 40 and who hardly ever gets a pimple i am highly disappointed with this product. I also very much disliked the applicator of this product.
